title: introduce-telemetry-composer-cost-advisor
author: Aisha Raman
body:
Summary: Adds a new service (Telemetry Composer) and CLI operator that ingests tenant inference telemetry (latency distribution, token counts, model variants used, hit-rate for prefix/KV cache) and synthesizes conservative, per-tenant defaults for batching, cache retention, and quantization profile suggestions. Motivation: customers repeatedly ask for reasonable starting defaults that lower unit economics without manual tuning. This PR encodes heuristics and a lightweight learned ranking model to produce safe recommendations, plus an operator to dry-run suggested settings in a shadow pool.

What changed (single string - sections kept in-line): Implemented telemetry-composer service (golang) that consumes normalized telemetry from the existing metrics-collector topic and materializes a compact tenant profile that includes: 95th/50th latency percentiles, median tokens-per-request, hot-route histogram, KV-cache hit rate, cold-start frequency, and observed model variant set. Introduced cost-advisor module that: (1) maps telemetry signatures to a small discrete set of batching templates (latency bands -> batch size/stride), (2) selects cache retention presets (none/min/standard/extended) based on observed reuse, (3) proposes quantization profiles (fp16/int8/awq-8) ranked by a conservative quality delta estimate. Added a dry-run operator (k8s CronJob) that applies suggested configs to a shadow-serving lane and collects simulated cost/latency delta. New CLI "rw-cost-advice" exposes: tenant report, suggestion export (YAML), and a --dry-run flag to publish to shadow lane.

Checklist: - [x] spec and design doc linked in PR (Linear ENG-2141) - [x] unit tests for mapping rules and serializer - [x] e2e smoke that runs dry-run against local shadow lane - [x] integration test for the metrics-collector -> telemetry-composer pipeline - [x] basic observability (prometheus metrics, structured logs) - [x] docs: console UI hints and API examples added to devdocs - [x] security review: read-only access to tenant metrics only

Backward compatibility & safety: suggestions are not auto-applied by default; all outputs are opinions with an attached risk score. The operator runs in dry-run mode by default and requires explicit opt-in for non-shadow application. We guarantee no change to serving runtime behavior unless the cluster operator runs the apply job.

Testing and validation: ran the dry-run across a synthetic mix of 50 tenants (high-throughput chat, long-seq summarization, embeddings) and measured median token-cost improvement of 11% with 95th percentile latency impact < 5% for recommended templates. See perf artifacts linked in the Linear ticket.

Usage examples: rw-cost-advice export --tenant=tenant-42 --format=yaml > tenant-42-suggest.yaml  # produces batching/cache/quant suggestions

Related work: builds on the prefill-sampler and prefiller telemetry introduced in ENG-1999 and complements the econ-suggester (ENG-2199).

Notes on design tradeoffs: the ranking model is intentionally small (XGBoost-like scoring over 12 features) to keep inference cheap and interpretable. We prefer conservative quantization suggestions for inference-sensitive tenants and fall back to safer batch/caching changes first.
commits: test: add unit tests for mapping rules (aisha)
infra: k8s CronJob for dry-run operator (marco)
docs: cost-advisor devdocs and console hints (eva)
chore: add prometheus metrics and structured logs (riley)
review_comments: Marco: Please add a feature flag gate for enabling non-shadow applies — addressed in commit 3d4b9f.
Eva: Can the ranker expose uncertainty scores? Suggest adding a calibrated confidence bucket. — responded, added risk_score field and tests.
Riley: Nit: prefer context-aware log keys; updated logging to include tenant_id and trace_id.
QA (Marta): Integration smoke failed on first CI run due to missing mock topic; fixed test harness and re-ran.
Security (Josh): Ensure no PII flows to logs — verified, logs are redacted.
Marco: Approve after small nits fixed.
merge_details: merged on 2025-11-12 by squash-merge. Commit message: feat(telemetry-composer): add cost advisor + CLI, docs, and dry-run operator. All CI checks passed.
release_notes: Introduces Telemetry Composer and Cost Advisor: a safe, opt-in automation that suggests tenant-level batching, cache retention, and quantization defaults based on observed telemetry. Includes rw-cost-advice CLI and a dry-run operator for shadow validation.
